envoy.label: Envoy
envoy.notes: Official release binary; dynamic forward proxy filter and cluster; one worker thread per pinned CPU (--concurrency).

goproxy.label: goproxy (Go)
goproxy.notes: goproxy/main.go: a minimal goproxy server, logging off; GOMAXPROCS follows the pinned CPUs (Go's default).

g3proxy.label: g3proxy (Rust)
g3proxy.notes: ByteDance's g3proxy (tokio), built from the g3proxy-v1.12.4 tag with --no-default-features --features rustls-ring; one worker runtime thread per pinned CPU.

squid.label: Squid
squid.notes: One process in the foreground (-N), caching and the access log off. Squid is single-threaded, so it uses one of the pinned CPUs.
